registration_timing: after v4 demographic/medoid findings;before v5 metrics
features: 16 physiology variables;age and gender excluded from distance;retained for descriptions
coverage_domains: at least1 vital and1 laboratory variable observed before imputation
distance: equal-weight numeric Gower;frozen training observed minmax;no outcome or demographic predictors

multiple_imputation.method: stochastic chained random-forest predictive mean matching;empirical donor values;flexible comparison,not proof of theoretical congeniality or proper Bayesian MI
multiple_imputation.cluster_pooling: mean Gower dissimilarity across10 imputations then PAM;compare individual-imputation partitions and aligned label support;not Rubin pooling

masked_observation_check: fixed10% of observed cells hidden within eligible training;fit imputation without hidden values;score MAE/IQR and RMSE/IQR byfeature;artificial masking does not validate actual missingness mechanism

stability.baseline_refit: median imputation and observed minmax refitted inside each subsample;full eligible train assigned to its medoids

threshold_decision: 8 remains registered main;6/10 are robustness comparisons,not a search for the nicest clustering;no unique optimum claim
masked_check_score: three independent stochastic draws and their mean, separately scored;not comparing a stochastic draw directly as an optimal point predictor
